title: Cue-guided dual-path reconstruction with adaptive multi-scale response refinement for low-light image enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2603.16482v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) supports optical sensing and scene observation when limited photon capture and sensor noise degrade image quality. However, existing methods can introduce colour deviations or blur local details in the enhanced images. To address this challenge, we propose CueDR-Net, a dual-path network that combines brightness adjustment with local content reconstruction through bidirectional cue interaction and adaptive multi-scale refinement. Specifically, a fixed extractor derives luminance variation, colour, and texture cue maps from the input image. These maps are encoded in a cue stream that exchanges features with the image stream through bidirectional attention. The exchanged features support two paths for brightness adjustment and local content reconstruction. translated_title: 面向低光照图像增强的线索引导双路径重建与自适应多尺度响应精化方法
translated_abstract: 低光照图像增强（LLIE）在光子捕获受限和传感器噪声导致图像质量下降的情况下，为光学感知和场景观测提供支持。然而，现有方法可能在增强后的图像中引入色彩偏差或模糊局部细节。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了CueDR-Net，这是一种双路径网络，通过双向线索交互和自适应多尺度精化，将亮度调整与局部内容重建相结合。具体而言，一个固定提取器从输入图像中推导出亮度变化、颜色和纹理线索图，这些线索图被编码到线索流中，并通过双向注意力与图像流交换特征。交换后的特征支持两条路径：亮度调整路径和局部内容重建路径。其中，亮度调整路径预测逐像素的调整图，用于控制输入图像的迭代强度变化。与此同时……
tldr: 提出CueDR-Net，一种通过双向线索交互与自适应多尺度精化，将亮度调整与局部内容重建相结合的双路径网络，有效解决低光照图像增强中的色彩偏差与局部细节模糊问题。
en_tdlr: We propose CueDR-Net, a dual-path network that combines brightness adjustment with local content reconstruction through bidirectional cue interaction and adaptive multi-scale refinement, effectively addressing colour deviations and local detail blurring in low-light image enhancement.
